description: This file contains template implementations of clamped mathematical operations (addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, etc.) for integral and floating-point types, with saturation behavior. It is part of the 'base' namespace, specifically 'base::internal', and includes functions for saturated negation and absolute value, as well as various clamped arithmetic operation structs.

classes.description: Template struct for saturated addition of integral types.
